comment: Class can be annoying but is required for the foreign language requirement. Easier compared to more intense foreign language options but I was very uninterested in the class content.

Dr. Bower was a good professor and overall this was a good class. My one problem was that I came in wanting a film class and got a German history class in which we studied films. Lots of readings, but she does a good job at helping you with short lectures at start of class. She's a fair grader and genuinely cares about her students.

Dr. Bower does move quickly, but she makes herself accessible if you need help. There are weekly quizzes in drill and a lot of canvas assignments to make sure you are working on your German outside of class.

I love Dr Bower! I took Germ472, and it was conceptually a lot with difficult texts and movies to watch, but I never felt overburdened in the class. She is very encouraging and supportive of all students and is perfectly reasonable without being walked all over by students. She's one of my favorite professors at Richmond!

Frau Bower loves to assign work on canvas to keep you always working on your German. She gives Thursday quizzes weekly in the drill class to make sure you're learning vocab. She does move a bit quickly but if you need help she is very nice and accessible during her office hours, and you can tell she really cares about her students doing well.
While we do have a lot of work in Canvas, the assignments are relatively easy. Tests are easy. Such a kind woman.

Dr Bower is amazing! She's hilarious in class and her workload is very manageable. She expects solid German, but she's not the type to correct you mid sentence. I loved this class and I would absolutely take more classes with her!!

Dr. Bower will push her students because that is the only way to learn a new language. Homework will be due for every class session but its only meant to reaffirm what we've been learning in class. She brings humor, a positive attitude, and energy to every single class. I would highly recommend Dr. Bower she is by a great teacher here at UR.

Frau Bower is a great German teacher. It's clear she understands the language and culture, important because German courses are very history related. She only speaks in German in class but it's if don't know how to say things. Emailing her in English is really helpful because she'll help you. Has a sense of humor too. She'll keep you late often.

I love Frau Bower! She is an amazing and nice teacher. While her tests and quizzes can be difficult she provides any and all resources needed so that you can do well. You will have to study every night but just enough to understand the information.
The toughest professor so far. Very smart and knowledgeable but expects too much of her students. Very hard class
Amazing! Interesting classes and very helpful!

She is a great professor,clear and you always know what she wants from you. She is a tough grader, but an A is definitely manageable. Listen in class and take notes and use them to write your essays. She is very helpful outside the classroom. Take advantage of the first draft, her comments will improve your grade drastically. STRONGLY RECOMMENDED
The best professor!

She is AMAZING! I mean, she's hard and material studied was hard, but she knows her stuff and she is so passionate about teaching and the material. You can really learn a lot! Even though she's a tough grader she is extremely helpful.

Representing the Holocaust was one of the the best classes I've ever taken at Richmond. Her lectures/discussions were soo interesting. I don't know why no one else likes her. I think she's great. So what if a prof's not personable if they're an awesome teacher.

Not hot.  She is a crazy hard grader and she does not really add much to the class.  No one enjoyed her lectures and the discussions were often pointless.  She is intelligent but needs to be more approachable for freshmen.

A good teacher, but hard grader. She tries to make the subject matter more intelligent than it needs to be. She will make you think, so if you like that she is good. If you want to just slack you are screwed!
Booooo!
Intelligent and funny. She added so much insight to our discussions. You need to work hard for a good grade.

She is the hardest professor I've had to date.  I think she expects too much of her students.  I had never even heard a German word before her class but soon she was demanding perfection.  She is the hardest grader but you do learn alot.  Study hard!

Very nice and helpful, and also the hardest germ prof I've ever had. She is too perfect and I think she needs to be in Grad School, where she can be teaching at a higher level suitable for her great intelligence. Though hard, I admired her
